# New scripts require an inline justification in this file.
# Format: scripts/path/to/file.py # reason
scripts/status/generate_plugin_scaffold_reports.py # generate scaffold file inventory, diff, and justification artifacts used by CI and status evidence
scripts/status/enforce_plugin_scaffold_policy.py # enforce that every scaffolded file is justified and decorative files stay excluded
scripts/status/generate_product_mount_readiness_reports.py # produce product-mount reservation registry/readiness/gap artifacts from canonical policy sources
scripts/status/generate_release_build_reports.py # generate release/debug size, dependency/license inventory, reproducibility assumptions, and release artifact manifest
scripts/status/check_deterministic_generation.py # verify schema, command-tree, and parity artifact generation remain deterministic
scripts/status/check_release_build_consistency.py # run repeated release builds and report binary hash consistency
scripts/status/generate_cleanup_reports.py # produce cleanup evidence and retention-policy artifacts for stale docs/snapshots/generated files
scripts/status/generate_next_minimalism_priorities.py # generate ranked simplification priorities and next_phase_minimalism artifacts from evidence reports
scripts/status/generate_command_migration_matrix.py # generate command migration matrix and status-model summaries consumed by dev cli status and CI
scripts/status/generate_command_surface_inventory.py # generate python-path, alias, and shim command inventories for migration closure evidence
scripts/status/generate_bridge_duplicate_law_report.py # generate python-bridge duplicate-law audit report to prove wrapper-only bridge behavior
scripts/status/enforce_bridge_duplicate_law_policy.py # enforce duplicate-law bridge report remains zero to prevent bridge-side command law drift
scripts/parity/check_binary_bridge_parity_gate.py # enforce binary-vs-python-bridge parity report has no exit/stdout/stderr drift
scripts/status/generate_install_neutrality_reports.py # generate install-neutrality and active-runtime truth artifacts from runtime/package diagnostics
scripts/status/enforce_install_neutrality_gate.py # enforce install ambiguity hardening tests and install-neutrality evidence completeness in CI
